verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for a feature-flag and experimentation platform, but the evidence shows no such capability. Several items are only adjacent and earn no credit. Scheduled rollouts and emergency kill switches roll back product features, not automations. Prompt versioning applies to AI prompts, not automations. Managing gates through the CLI in CI/CD pipelines is a user-side workaround.
